prompt: Here's a comprehensive solution-architect breakdown for a two-sided digital-goods marketplace (buyers browse and purchase digital goods; sellers list items, manage inventory/licenses, and receive payouts) with ~15 capabilities spanning seller onboarding, listing/asset management, search, checkout, payment, digital delivery/entitlements, refunds/chargebacks, seller ledger, payouts, reviews, moderation, and notifications. Do a comprehensive technical architecture and tech stack for the entire platform. Design for growth to millions of users.
assertions: Output contains 'Source Breakdown' section referencing the capability set
Output contains 'Constraints & Assumptions' section capturing the large-scale target
Output contains 'Architecture Overview' section with a named architecture style and rationale appropriate for scale
Output contains 'Tech Stack' section
Output contains 'Capability → Tech Mapping' section
Output contains 'Key Architecture Decisions' section with multiple ADR-style entries
Output contains 'Risks & Tradeoffs' section
Output contains 'Research Suggestions' section
Output contains 'Open Questions' section
Output contains 'Next Steps' section
Depth level is marked as 'deep'
Tech stack covers frontend, backend, data storage, async/messaging, auth, infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, third-party integrations, and security
Each tech stack layer gives a Recommendation, a Why/rationale, and at least one Alternative
Architecture style choice (e.g., microservices/event-driven) is justified by the scale and capability breadth
Search capability is addressed with a dedicated search technology
Payment processing and seller payouts are addressed (e.g., a payments/marketplace provider, ledger)
Digital delivery/entitlements is addressed (object storage + access control / signed delivery)
Async/event-driven processing is used for cross-cutting flows (e.g., notifications, payouts, moderation)
Capability mapping covers the major capability areas (buyer, seller, payments, delivery, trust/moderation)
Describes HOW (technologies, architecture), NOT new features or capabilities
Flags at least 2 high-stakes choices for the researcher skill with ready-to-use queries
Does NOT attempt to persist/save the output — suggests librarian skill instead
Output ends with a suggestion to use the librarian skill for persistence
